props: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Godot 2D pixel-art environment atlas, six separated transparent sprites, production assets not a scene. Edit this atlas to a grounded, somber, adult post-Soviet woodland outpost in overcast late afternoon after rain. Preserve exactly its six objects, cell positions, bounding silhouettes, front-facing top-down 3/4 projection and transparent background: cabin upper-left, conifer upper-middle, tarp log pile upper-right, fence lower-left, supply chest lower-middle, rocks lower-right. Cabin: weathered grey timber, dull zinc roof, boarded small window with restrained warm amber glow, tiny weathered woven twig charm above door (subtle folklore, no fantasy glow). Conifer: irregular slightly sparse branches, subdued grey-green needles, no bright mint highlights. Logs and fence: damp desaturated grey-brown wood, worn taupe tarpaulin. Chest: utilitarian scratched steel, muted brown-olive, no emblems. Rocks: damp slate, small ochre lichen. Medium-value readable diffuse overcast illumination; fully readable sprites, not nighttime, no crushed black surfaces. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters and limited palette, simple readable edges; avoid plush cartoon, glossy toy rendering, thick black comic outlines, saturated orange wood, vibrant greens, fog overlays, dramatic cast shadows, text, additional objects, ground plane, background, cropped objects. Same atlas layout with generous transparent separation so each sprite can be extracted independently.
ground: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: game ground texture atlas with two equal side-by-side square panels, flat overhead pixel art. Edit the supplied atlas for a damp somber adult woodland clearing under diffuse overcast late afternoon light. Keep exactly the two-panel layout: left half seamless muted grey-olive low grass and sparse pine-needle ground, right half seamless grey-taupe packed earth with small stones. Replace sunny yellow-green and orange-brown with restrained grey-green and warm grey-brown. Medium values and clear material contrast, not nighttime, no heavy black, no vignettes or light hotspots. Subtle short irregular grass, a few ochre dead needles, soft damp earth variation, no large puddles, no tall vegetation or obstacles, no objects. Controlled low-contrast pixel texture that does not compete with characters or loot. Crisp pixel clusters, no blur, no perspective, no shadows, no labels, no text. Both panels individually tile seamlessly on all edges. Preserve panel dimensions and layout.
scout: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent 2D pixel-art walk-cycle sprite sheet for Godot, not concept painting. One consistent adult woodland scavenger, serious subdued survival atmosphere. Lean practical proportions with small head around 1/6 total height, broad enough shoulders and long legs, no chibi proportions or cute face. Weathered ash-grey hood over a dark knit cap, stern face in shade with tiny stubble pixels, dusty olive-grey short field jacket, faded tan scarf, dark slate trousers, muddy brown boots, compact worn brown canvas pack with one muted ochre strap. No helmet, gas mask, neon, symbols, badges or logos. Original design, not a franchise character. Soft readable overcast daylight; strong medium-value silhouette and a few restrained light edges, not night. Strict FOUR columns by THREE rows evenly spaced, twelve full-body sprites on genuine transparency, same size and foot baseline per row, generous empty cell margins. Row1 facing down toward camera; row2 right-facing profile; row3 facing up/back. Each row four walking phases: legs near together (idle-compatible), left leg forward, passing near together, right leg forward. Hands held compactly near waist, no weapons in hands (game draws gun separately). Upright fixed camera 3/4 top-down like classic tactical pixel game, same projection for all sprites. Deliberate crisp pixel clusters, limited palette, simple angular anatomy, no soft painting, no toy/chibi/Pixar/Disney styling, no huge head, no big eyes, no glossy outlines, no shadow or floor, no text, no grid. Each sprite about 150 px wide x 260 px tall on a 1536x1024 sheet; preserve clear gaps between all twelve sprites.
guard: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent 2D pixel-art walk-cycle sprite sheet for Godot. One consistent adult hostile woodland watchman, grounded serious survival atmosphere, visually distinct from grey-hooded player. Proportions lean adult, head 1/6 total height, shoulders and long legs, no chibi. Faded rust-brown padded field coat, dark battered steel helmet with small face opening and shadowed stern face, desaturated tan canvas chest rig, charcoal trousers, dark boots, small brown utility pack. Small dull red-brown cloth armband, no icons or insignia, no franchise character, no gas mask, no neon. Readable overcast daylight and medium values. Strict FOUR columns by THREE rows, twelve full-body sprites on genuine transparent background, same size and feet baseline per row, ample transparent margins. Row1 facing down/toward camera; row2 right-facing profile; row3 up/back. Four walking phases each row: feet near together (idle-compatible), left forward, passing near together, right forward. Hands compact at waist, no weapon (separate in game). Upright 3/4 top-down tactical pixel-art projection consistent all views. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, restricted palette, angular restrained anatomy. No cartoon/toy/chibi rendering, no oversized head or eyes, no glossy paint, no floor, no shadows, no text, no cell lines. Each sprite approximately 150px wide x260px high within a 1536x1024 sheet.
